## Design

### 2026-10-10 – I designed the first part of the wind tunnel, which is the inlet. The inlet is an opening that draws drived air into the circuit. It isolates the tunnel from outside disturbances, and it also transfor

**2h**

I designed the first part of the wind tunnel, which is the inlet. The inlet is an opening that draws drived air into the circuit. It isolates the tunnel from outside disturbances, and it also transforms the air into a smooth, straight-line stream. I attached a real-world example of an inlet.

### 2026-10-10 – I designed the next part of the wind tunnel, which is the nozzle. The nozzle is a contoured section that is placed just before the test section, and it is used to accelerate the airflow and create a s

**2h**

I designed the next part of the wind tunnel, which is the nozzle. The nozzle is a contoured section that is placed just before the test section, and it is used to accelerate the airflow and create a smooth stream. I attached a picture that I used as inspiration for my design of the nozzle.
